about.text: To amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to provide further transparency and accountability for the use of content that is generated by artificial intelligence (generative AI) in political advertisements by requiring such advertisements to include a statement within the contents of the advertisements if generative AI was used to generate any image or video footage in the advertisements, and for other purposes.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on House Administration.

effective.note: Not enacted as of the date of the data (stage reached: Introduced). A bill becomes law only when both chambers pass the same text and the President signs it, lets it become law without a signature, or is overridden. It has no effective date.
